definition: a nobleman of the lowest rank
description: At the tall wrought-iron gates of a grand stone castle with towers on a sunny day, a smiling young man in a green tweed jacket, checked shirt and tie swings one gate wide open and steps aside to let villagers in for a summer fair. People carry a wooden folding table, a woman in a pink dress hurries in with a cake tin and a scruffy dog runs past. An old man in a tweed waistcoat holding a ring of keys watches, and bunting and a small flag lie on the gravel.
